      "title": "Past crisis replay",
      "body": "In a replay of the 2008–09 financial crisis, the portfolio fell by 40.3%, or $264,672. It took 22.1 months to recover in that replay.",

      "title": "Fees over time",

      "title": "Retirement income estimate",

This planning estimate assumes real returns after fees of 1.8%–5.8%, a 3.9% withdrawal rate, and a flat 15% tax on pre-tax accounts; planning estimate, not a guarantee.",
